name: Jehoram
bio:
Jehoram succeeded his father Jehoshaphat as king of Judah after Jehoshaphat's twenty-five-year reign ended and he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David (1 Kings 22:50).

## 📖 Core Story: Marriage into Ahab's House

Jehoram began to reign over Judah at thirty-two, in the fifth year of Joram (Jehoram) son of Ahab, and reigned eight years in Jerusalem. He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, as Ahab's house had, because he had married Ahab's daughter Athaliah, and he did evil in the LORD's eyes — though the LORD spared Judah from destruction for David's sake. In his reign, Edom revolted from Judah's rule and set up its own king; Jehoram struck the surrounding Edomites by night at Zair, but Edom's revolt succeeded anyway, and Libnah revolted at the same time. Jehoram died and was buried in the City of David, and his son Ahaziah succeeded him (2 Kings 8:16-24).
